results.title: World Darts Championship 2026 results - BBC Sport
excerpts:
Published 10 December 2025 Updated 3 January 2026 Luke Littler retained his PDC World Darts Championship title with a 7-1 victory over reigning European and World Youth champion Gian van Veen in the final at Alexandra Palace in London. World number one Littler, 18, has appeared in three consecutive finals - he beat Michael van Gerwen in 2025, a year after finishing runner-up to Luke Humphries on his debut at the event. By winning the title again, Littler became the first player since 2016 to successfully defend the PDC world crown. A record 128 players entered the tournament, increasing from the 96 players that featured in last year's competition.

excerpts: PDC by Samuel Gill Monday, 03 August 2026 at 17:53 Littler/Sinner Follow us on Google! 0 Luke Littler has no doubts: according to the 19-year-old Englishman, there is currently no athlete in the world performing as dominantly in 2026 as he is. The world No. 1 has won all six televised PDC major titles staged so far this year and is on course for a truly historic season. ADVERTISEMENT Littler has already captured the World Championship, Masters, UK Open, Premier League Darts, World Cup of Darts, and World Matchplay in 2026. He is now chasing an unprecedented achievement: winning all 11 major PDC tournaments in a single calendar year. His prize money on the PDC Order of Merit has also climbed to more than £3.1 million.
